about: SequenceMatcher alone (the app's class, current rules: per-jutsu counters, a wrong sign keeps the progress, 7 s limit in Live, none in Practice) fed one uniformly random sign every 1.8-3.6 s, for 200.0 simulated hours. It shows how often signs made in NO particular order complete a jutsu by chance. Recognition is assumed perfect here; the spliced random streams of the 'sequences' part include the real recognisers.
